note: FNS Section 1114 is a pure cross-reference section that directs QC reviewers to variance-handling procedures in Sections 1130.4 (dependent care), 1161 (SUA), and 1170.5 (medical deductions). It contains no substantive policy rules itself. The referenced sections (1130.4, 1161, 1170.5) are QC review procedures — they instruct reviewers how to handle variances (discrepancies between what the eligibility worker did and what should have been done) during quality control reviews. These are audit methodology, not caseworker guidance. The underlying policy rules about dependent care deductions, SUA, and medical deductions are covered by their parent FNS sections (1130, 1160, 1170) and are separately evaluated. The OLG appropriately covers the caseworker-relevant aspects of these deductions (e.g., 'Dependent Care Expenses Deduction', 'Non-Recurring Medical Expenses', 'Standard Utility Allowance Expense Introduction') without needing to address QC variance procedures.
